```python
# Search for the 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15
intro_event = search_calendar_events(query="Introductory meeting", date="2024-05-15")

# Check if the event was found
if not intro_event:
    raise ValueError("Introductory meeting event not found on 2024-05-15")

# Get the participants from the found event
participants = intro_event[0].participants

# Create the new 'Follow-up meeting' event
# Start time: 2024-05-16 10:00
# End time: 2024-05-16 11:00 (1 hour duration)
new_event = create_calendar_event(
    title="Follow-up meeting",
    start_time="2024-05-16 10:00",
    end_time="2024-05-16 11:00",
    description="Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.",
    participants=participants,
    location=None
)

print(f"Created event: {new_event.title} on {new_event.start_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
```
